notes: Read-only review of both files. Traced the base window (fy+1..fy+5 gives focal years t-5..t-1), the forward window (fy-1..fy-3 gives focal years t+1..t+3, year t excluded from both), the anti-join for F minus B, the empty-base NA rule, the no-forward 0 rule, deduplication, and the five output columns, and found no deviation. Two benign extras not stated in the spec: a blank cpc_subclass is treated as missing, which only matters if blank strings occur, and the 1987-2015 focal range is taken from firm_year rather than enforced in build.R.
